result.title: Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion
result.comment: 11 pages (8-page main paper and 3-page supplementary material), 3 figures, 12 tables
result.summary: Color walking video records body boundary motion alongside clothing folds, surface appearance, and recording-environment cues. To examine what an explicit binary silhouette contributes to participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait when a classifier already observes the paired color sequence, we construct Scoliosis5K, a multi-site collection of 4,998 corridor-walking sequences across 3,010 participant identifiers in which RGB person crops, binary silhouettes, and two-dimensional poses share each recording identifier and frame index. Our architecture uses each patch's pixel deviation from its clip mean to weight two low-rank query and value updates inside a pretrained RGB encoder, fusing the resulting video representation with a silhouette transformer sequence and regional kernel ridge scores extracted from one native-resolution RGB frame per window. Across 988 participants in five participant-disjoint cross-validation folds and three training seeds, the complete system reaches 83.77% accuracy and 79.91% macro-averaged F1, compared with 83.27% accuracy and 79.56% macro-F1 when the video RGB encoder remains frozen under identical inputs. Zeroing the silhouette vector at fixed weights shifts overall accuracy by only 0.10 percentage points while raising positive-category recall from 68.52% to 77.78% and lowering recall for both remaining categories. Macro-averaged AUROC is 0.950 across the cohort and 0.879 among participant pairs matched on acquisition site and recording-count group.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 Scoliosis5K 多站点步态数据集（RGB 人像裁剪、二值轮廓、二维姿态按帧对齐），在预训练 RGB 编码器内用各 patch 相对片段均值的像素偏移加权低秩更新，再融合轮廓序列与区域核岭回归分数，做受试者级脊柱侧弯步态分类，并报告完整系统与冻结编码器、置零轮廓向量下的对照结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 医学步态分类本身不在主线上，但其在固定权重下置零某一视觉证据通道以度量该通道对预测的边际贡献，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 是否真正使用视觉证据」的贡献分配与消融设计思路；用片段均值偏差调制编码器更新的做法也可能为视觉旁路适配提供线索。
